title: EXP-019 — Fresh-Dialog Classic Wizard Selection
objective: Test a distinct end-to-end visible interaction path for the prerequisite that blocked EXP-018: fresh dialog + native rendered selection of both Category and Wizard, without typed dropdown values. Cancel the previously used Form Wizard Selection dialog after the permitted preflight, open a fresh selection dialog, choose Classic and then Build from Scratch from their rendered dropdown options, and submit the selection dialog once. EXP-018 already clicked the visible Build from Scratch option and used the Category dropdown later after typing; neither native interaction alone is new. The tested difference is the complete fresh-dialog sequence with no typed values. Dialog recreation and the untyped selection sequence vary together, so this is not single-variable causal isolation. Observe whether the first Build-from-Scratch wizard page appears, then stop before name entry, page advancement, or artifact creation. Saving and persistence verification do not apply. A success establishes only that this visible sequence was accepted in this attempt; it cannot identify whether reopening, Category selection, Wizard reselection, or their combination was decisive.

in_scope: Read the existing basic-form recipe and the EXP-018 failure record before browser interaction
Inspect the current visible Designer session, editing scope, active form, open dialogs, and clean/dirty state; preserve baseline evidence

Only after visibly confirming the loaded form is clean and no target artifact or partially completed creation wizard exists, dismiss the known No wizard form selected alert through its visible OK button and cancel the existing Form Wizard Selection dialog through its visible Cancel button

Open Form Wizard Selection once through Web Designer New Form Definition, with New Form selected; capture the freshly opened dialog before changing either dropdown. Reopening is an intentional part of the tested procedure, not a neutral reset.

Select Category Classic through its rendered dropdown option, then select Build from Scratch / Plain form without defined components through its rendered dropdown option. For each field, capture both the rendered option before selection and its visible selected state afterward, without typing any dropdown value.
Click the Form Wizard Selection OK button at most once and inspect whether the first Build-from-Scratch wizard page appears or an alert rejects selection
Stop at the first wizard page without filling it; alternatively stop on the rejection, inaccessible option, or ambiguous state and record a blocker
Write the diagnostic record and important screenshots under the EXP-019 paths only
out_of_scope: Creating, saving, modifying, deleting, or completing any form, component, template, or database artifact
Button Caption persistence or continuation of EXP-018
FormSync operations, variables, events, scripts, IDOs, portals, or other UI stacks
Changing editing scope, environment, authentication, application instance, or model configuration
Investigating hidden registries, internal keys, framework stores, or backend implementation

prohibited_actions: Never modify any existing artifact, including the currently loaded non-FX_ form; never modify production data or disable security
Do not enter a new form name, click Next or Finish, save a form or template, or complete the creation wizard
Do not type Classic, BuildFromScratch, or another guessed internal key into the dropdown fields; use rendered options with native interactions only
No JavaScript evaluation, script execution, Ext component/store access, hidden or off-screen controls, synthetic events, internal APIs, direct SQL, or reverse-engineered requests
Do not reload, navigate directly to another URL, restart a browser/backend, sign out, or reauthenticate to recover
Do not dismiss or bypass any unexpected alert, dirty-state prompt, partially completed wizard, or permission request; report the blocker

No second wizard-selection submission, alternate selection strategy, or repeated creation attempt; at most one fresh snapshot and one corrected visible inspection for an inaccessible control, then stop
Do not read secret files, credential values, or unrelated local files; use only the recorded experiment, recipe, environment, and EXP-019 evidence
Do not infer a cause from a label, selected textbox value, absence of errors, or unseen content; separate visible facts from hypotheses
Do not start another experiment or use a new worker session to reset the single-attempt boundary
Do not attribute any successful selection to a particular action, internal cause, or neutral reset; dialog recreation and the untyped two-dropdown selection sequence are tested together

environment.notes: The last recorded Designer state contains the Form Wizard Selection dialog and No wizard form selected alert. This is historical context, not proof of the current live state. Reconfirm state and User scope before any dialog interaction. An unclear or expired session is a blocker, not authorization to reset it.

acceptance_checks.description: Baseline evidence visibly establishes a live Designer session, User editing scope, loaded-form identity and clean state, and existing dialogs before interaction. Stop blocked if these prerequisites cannot be established.

Evidence identifies the freshly opened selection dialog and separately shows the rendered Classic option and its visible selected state, then the rendered Build from Scratch option and its visible selected state. Record the native interaction used for each selection and confirm neither field received typed input. Selected field text alone is insufficient proof of choosing a rendered option.

Following at most one selection-dialog OK submission, decisive visible evidence identifies the first Build-from-Scratch wizard page before name entry or page advancement. If rejection persists or the page cannot be identified, this check fails and the experiment is blocked. A success supports only that the complete visible sequence was accepted in this attempt; it does not establish causation, form creation, repeatability, or persistence.

The record lists the exact interaction sequence, evidence, final UI state and errors; confirms no name entry, Next/Finish/Save, creation or artifact modification; and includes this comparison: EXP-018 already visibly clicked Build from Scratch and interacted with Category after typing; EXP-019 differs by starting from a freshly opened selection dialog and establishing both selections through rendered options without typed values. State that reopening and the untyped selection sequence vary together, and that a success cannot distinguish their individual effects. Classify success only as observed for this attempt and explicitly exclude persistence and internal-cause claims.

initial_instruction: Read recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md and experiments/EXP-018-button-caption-recovery-across-ordinary-close-reop.md, then inspect the browser state and repository baseline. EXP-018 already used the rendered wizard option and later Category dropdown interaction after typing, so these alone are not new. Execute only the fresh-dialog path defined in this brief, after the live session, User scope, clean loaded form, and absence of a partially completed creation wizard are established. After the permitted alert dismissal and cancellation of the used selection dialog, capture one freshly opened selection dialog. Choose both Category Classic and Wizard Build from Scratch from rendered dropdown options, without typing either value. Capture each option and its selected state before the one selection-dialog submission, and the resulting first page or rejection afterward. Stop before entering a form name or advancing. If prerequisites or selection fail, write the diagnostic record and report blocked. Do not retry or widen the approach. Include the required comparison to EXP-018 and state that this tests the combined visible sequence, not the cause of any success. Keep the final report concise with actions, observed result, evidence paths, final UI state, and limitations.
notes: Prepared after EXP-018 completed blocked on No wizard form selected. Revised on 2026-10-05 following the operator-provided specialist review; see briefs/EXP-019.specialist-review.md. The saved T1 transcript records typing before later Category dropdown interaction and visible wizard selection, and no cancel/reopen sequence was found. This supports treating the full fresh-dialog/no-typing sequence as a distinct procedural test, not proof of a new individual UI action or a cause. The specialist review supports the distinction conditionally and requested these wording/evidence corrections; no explicit final verdict block was supplied. This draft remains unreviewed pending operator approval. No artifact creation is permitted, this is not a replay or verified procedure, and autopilot remains off.
